Progress in the mode of failure.
Come into your own where you inherit your failure!!
And carry out progress in the mode of failure!
That would make a fine antistrophe to the many forms of terror in the Song of the Sixty-Year-Old!
The Catholic lay intellectual who speaks publicly is normally a comic figure—and in great cases, such as Donoso, a tragicomic one.
Who exactly is he talking to?
Inside the domain of the celibate bureaucracy he has nothing to say.
Outside it, people must take him for an altar boy.
A just punishment for this idiot of an intellectual layman.
Why does he insist on speaking when all he is allowed to say is Yes and Amen?
A naked, unclothed intellectual standing among prelates decked out in pomp!
Ubi nihil vales, ibi nihil velis
—where you have no power, desire nothing—without being punished for it.

If a person starts preaching instead of dutifully acclaiming—that is, instead of saying Yes and Amen—he merely causes embarrassing attention. But look: atheist rationalists and Marxists such as Georg Lukács suddenly find themselves in exactly the same tragicomic situation and are instructed by their own headquarters about their true function. So perhaps we could all quite happily philosophize together about knowledge and power, sagesse et tyrannie—wisdom and tyranny—without insulting one another and criminalizing one another as traitors to the spirit.
By creating the world out of nothing, God thereby made Nothing into Something it had not been before: Something from which a world can be created.
This whole beautiful world was created out of nothing?
Well, it certainly looks like it.
Which only makes this Nothing from which it was created more and more interesting.
The problem of the order: wine—woman—song.
Material for a new world war.
I find it unbelievable that wine comes before woman.
The identity formula homo homini homo lies at the core of the identity between rulers and ruled—that is, at the core of democracy itself.
Anyone who denies it cannot be a democrat.
Yesterday I became agitated for a moment when George Schwab read the note at the end of my opinion of 25 August 1945 on aggressive war:
How can Hitler’s scelus infandum—his unspeakable crime—be atoned for?
Surely not through a judicial process!

That would strip it of its unbelievable character and standardize it. It would turn the crime into a procedure, into a precedent, and place it inside the realm of what can be foreseen—and reviewed afterward.
Hugo Ball criticized my Political Romanticism with the remark:
To hunt one rabbit—Adam Müller—an entire province is sealed off.
But that sealing-off produced the first map of the province.
Three grim prophecies for the Germans:
To reach your Reich, Germans, you struggle in vain.
To form yourselves into a nation, Germans, you hope in vain.
(With , the Jew has backing; see Karl Kraus.)
To become a people, Germans, you wish in vain.
Why exactly did Ernst Bloch become so furious when I spoke of the “proletarian consciousness of having been cheated”?
I said it as a proletarian myself.
Admittedly, a different kind of proletarian from his.
Not a proletarian hungry for loot.

All I have left is progress in the consciousness of having been cheated. From time to time I change the kind of person I allow to cheat me. Then the discarded swindler rages after me and calls me a characterless traitor.
Good Werner Becker expects Rome to make a confession of guilt because of the Renaissance popes.
Rome will gladly give him one.
And are today’s dollar-and-rejuvenation popes really better and more Christian than those genuine sinners?

Those genuine sinners at least still held the trump card of pecca fortiter—sin boldly—and by their very existence could refute Luther eo ipso. Today’s popes, by contrast, are merely normativists and righteous peacemakers. Peacemakers with retirement insurance and a right to a long, edifying earthly life. That is: a right to die of old age.
We should not envy them for it. If I had the power, I would gladly guarantee every one of them death from old age.

Today human beings use technology to create their own environment. They cease to be endangered living creatures and attain an improbably advanced age in complete security, with well-organized provision for every need. But in doing so, they cease to be the endangered living creature that remains “open” and is bound to no fixed environment. They become animals, like other animals.
No wonder there has never been so much talk about Man and humanity as there is today.
Aubrey Beardsley seems to be proving right:
The entire Western world is Hamlet and will give its dying voice to a Fortinbras.

A Kunde comes with a Kunde—a customer comes bearing news. He even comes with an Ur-Kunde—an original document.
Urkunde: it has already been written down, and yet it still calls itself Ur—original, primordial—and all the more exclusively “original.” Meanwhile other scribes are writing.
The Roman scribes in Rome, who for a thousand years deceived Europe with pseudo-Isidorian original documents, now find themselves facing unfair competition.
At least these customers notice that every painter who paints abstractly today also be-ur-kundet—certifies, documents, bears witness. They experience that as unfair competition.
Naturally, it has to be stopped. And any stoppage will do.
Then Stalin and Roosevelt—par nobile fratrum, a noble pair of brothers.
Then someone else who will eventually conclude another concordat with the old producers of “original documents” in Rome.

But the producers of original documents in Rome could issue their documents only in the pseudo-Isidorian style. For that purpose Holy Scripture was good enough for them as the holy Ur-Urkunde—the original original document—complete with primordial fresh-cell interpretations.
